name: Terrace
author: Erin Carter
description: An invisible drifting terrain posterized into filled stepped bands --- rice paddies at dusk seen from straight above. Broad calm near-dark plates separated by luminous hairline edges; terraces creep, flood and drain as the heightfield deforms at geological patience.

params.label: Bands
params.effect: Number of posterized elevation steps; fewer gives broad calm plates, more gives a finely terraced hillside.

params.label: Morph speed
params.effect: How fast the underlying terrain deforms --- the rate terraces creep, flood and drain.

params.label: Edge glow
params.effect: Brightness of the hairline edges between steps, from fills-only at 0 to luminous wire boundaries at max.
